domain: Survey and photogrammetry: mission planning for DJI consumer aircraft, open photogrammetry engines, point-cloud and GIS deliverables (hand-verified 2026-10-09 against plugins.qgis.org, GitHub, archlinux.org and the AUR)
notes: Capture constraint read from DJI's Product SDK Compatibility page on 2026-10-09: the Mini 5 Pro, Mavic 4 Pro, Flip, Neo, Neo 2, Avata 360, Lito X1 and Lito 1 have no Mobile SDK, so Dronelink, Litchi, Map Pilot Pro, DroneDeploy and Pix4Dcapture cannot fly them; missions are DJI WPML KMZ files flown by the aircraft's own waypoint engine and loaded by overwriting a dummy mission in the DJI Fly waypoint folder. WebODM decoupled from the OpenDroneMap organisation on 2026-04-06 and processes with its own ODX engine (both AGPL-3.0); OpenDroneMap's ODM continues separately. AGPL and GPL components run as containers, processes or user-profile plugins, never linked into aces-* code. Packaged as aces-survey (QGIS + FlyPath + pinned WebODM tree; CloudCompare, COLMAP and Meshroom optional until their AUR recipes are forked).
unverified_candidates: Nerfstudio and gsplat (Apache-2.0) for splat visualisation
RTKLIB with a u-blox ZED-F9P as a GCP survey kit
NodeODX on the rig as a remote processing node
OpenDroneMap Desktop as an alternative GUI
DJI Mini 5 Pro minimum timed-shot interval at 50 MP

rows.name: QGIS
rows.adds: Desktop GIS that hosts the FlyPath planner and produces the deliverables: orthomosaic styling, contours, cut-and-fill volumes, map layouts
rows.gotcha: GPL: separate process; plugins live in the user profile (QGIS 4 still uses the QGIS3 profile folder)

rows.name: FlyPath
rows.adds: QGIS plugin that exports DJI WPML KMZ missions for DJI Fly: 2D grid, corridor and orbit, terrain follow, cross-hatch, battery splitting, semi-automatic (timed shot) or full-automatic (waypoint per photo) capture; Mini 5 Pro community-verified
rows.packaging: qgis plugin zip 3.0.0 (plugins.qgis.org, 6 Oct 2026; sha256 2c9f6046…5579), vendored in aces-survey and installed per user
rows.gotcha: needs python-shapely and python-pyproj; DJI Fly has no import button, so the KMZ overwrites a dummy mission in the app's waypoint folder and the app may reset the flight speed

rows.name: WebODM
rows.adds: Web console over the ODX engine: orthomosaics, DSM/DTM, point clouds, textured meshes, Gaussian splats, ground control points, task queue and processing nodes
rows.packaging: docker (webodm/webodm_webapp, webodm/webodm_db, redis, webodm/nodeodx); release tree v3.3.0 (5 Sep 2026, sha256 c2d72ca2…4ae6) pinned in aces-survey
rows.gotcha: decoupled from OpenDroneMap on 2026-04-06 (same name, different organisation); the GPU node needs nvidia-container-toolkit; webodm.sh only adds the NVIDIA compose file when GPU_NVIDIA=true and its own detection is Linux-only

rows.name: ODX
rows.adds: Photogrammetry engine behind WebODM: fork of ODM with OpenSfM 1.0, GPU feature matching, RTX 50 series support and checkpoints
rows.packaging: docker webodm/nodeodx and webodm/nodeodx:gpu (pulled at run time)
rows.gotcha: no Arch package; usable from the CLI with docker run as well

rows.name: OpenDroneMap ODM
rows.adds: The original command-line photogrammetry toolkit, with an OpenDroneMap Desktop GUI from opendronemap.org
rows.gotcha: separate project from WebODM since 2026-04; attach NodeODM to WebODM as another processing node if ever needed

rows.name: CloudCompare
rows.adds: Point-cloud and mesh processing: cleaning, cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-mesh distances, volumes, registration, sections
rows.packaging: aur cloudcompare 2.13.2-4 and cloudcompare-git (bartus); upstream portable Windows 7z
rows.fit: day-one (optional until the recipe is forked)
rows.gotcha: AUR only; 2.14 in beta; GPL separate process

rows.name: COLMAP
rows.adds: SfM and MVS pipeline with full control of matching and bundle adjustment; the usual front end for Gaussian splatting

rows.name: Meshroom
rows.adds: AliceVision node graph for textured 3D models of buildings and objects
rows.gotcha: depth maps need CUDA; AUR only

rows.name: DroneRoute
rows.adds: Self-hosted web mission planner with a grid-survey template, WPML KMZ export and import, and a CLI that pushes a KMZ to a USB-connected DJI RC over adb
rows.gotcha: lists Mini 4 Pro, not yet the Mini 5 Pro; same KMZ format

rows.name: YMapper
rows.adds: Cross-platform (desktop and Android) survey-mission generator for DJI Fly and Litchi, formerly DJI-Mapper

rows.name: NVIDIA Container Toolkit
rows.adds: Docker nvidia runtime that webodm/nodeodx:gpu needs
rows.gotcha: optional dependency of aces-survey; without it the stack falls back to the CPU node

rows.name: Shapely and pyproj
rows.adds: Geometry and projection libraries the FlyPath engine imports
rows.gotcha: QGIS on Arch uses the system Python, so these must be system packages
